description: A dark, painterly parlour interior with a glossy black grand piano, lid raised, and an open music book on the stand. Tall arched windows stand open onto a moonlit garden and a still pond reflecting a full moon. Damask wallpaper, drapes, a patterned rug and a gilt mirror edge at the right are part of the room. No people. A tiny illegible gilt maker's mark sits on the piano fallboard. The painting fills the image edge to edge.
